Application Data.NAME: Smith & Associates Tax Services
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Associates Tax Services provides comprehensive tax preparation and accounting services, specializing in individual tax returns, bookkeeping, and regulatory compliance. Our team of certified professionals ensures accuracy and confidentiality in all client transactions. We utilize advanced cybersecurity measures, including multi-factor authentication and regular data backups, to protect sensitive client information. Our operations are strictly office-based, allowing for a controlled environment that minimizes physical risks while maximizing service quality. We maintain comprehensive Errors and Omissions (E&O) coverage to safeguard against potential professional liability claims, demonstrating our commitment to risk management and client integrity.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, the firm experienced a data breach due to a phishing attack, which compromised client records. The estimated loss was $10,000 for credit monitoring services and IT forensic investigations. The incident has been resolved, and no client data was leaked. Claims have been closed as of 04/10/2023.
